title: boykinia jamesii var. heucheriformis
intro: Boykinia jamesii var. heucheriformis, commonly known as Heucherella, is a hybrid plant that originated from the cross between Heuchera and Tiarella. This plant is known for its attractive foliage and delicate white flowers. Research has shown that Heucherella possesses various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Heucherella include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may provide therapeutic actions such as anti-oxidative stress, wound healing, and antiviral activities.
